neighbours.label: the modifier slot just before 'cities' (major, other, largest, medium-size)
fire: Air pollution is worst in the largest cities of India.
The festival tours Lyon and several other French cities each summer.
Rents have risen sharply in most major cities this year.
A tram network in a mid-size city can cut traffic noticeably.
Concerts are repeated in Madrid and other Spanish towns.
The study ranked 100 major cities by quality of life.
Smog chokes even the biggest cities of the region in winter.
The new metro links the capital with other big cities.
quiet: Air pollution is worst in the largest factories of India.
The festival tours Lyon and several other French vineyards each summer.
Rents have risen sharply in most major sectors this year.
A new tram line can cut traffic noticeably.
Concerts are repeated in Madrid and other Spanish festivals.
The study ranked 100 major universities by quality of teaching.
Floods hit even the biggest farms of the region in winter.
The new metro links the airport with the old harbour.

notes: Output promotes ' city', ' cities', ' capitals'. The - pole is place-relative geography ('25 km south of the Sydney CBD').
